column1: # mapping_set_description: Manually curated alignment of the Mellea LinkML schema (linkml/src/mellea/schema/mellea.yaml) to the SPDX 3 LinkML schema (linkml/src/mellea/mappings/spdx/). Subjects are Mellea schema elements (classes and enum permissible values); objects are SBOM/AI-package concepts from the SPDX schema. The strongest alignments centre on AI model packaging (SPDX AIPackage) and on document/element provenance primitives (Sbom, Package, Element, Annotation).

column8: ModelIdentifierSpec is the cross-provider name table for an AI model; SPDX AIPackage is the SBOM package type representing that AI model.
Intrinsic adapters are themselves shippable AI model artefacts (LoRA / aLoRA) and best modelled as SPDX AIPackages.
RepositoryCatalog is a top-level, dated catalogue of the analysed code; SPDX Sbom is a top-level inventory document. Both are tree-root containers of elements.
SpdxDocument is the generic SPDX document container; conceptually adjacent to the Mellea catalogue.
PythonPackage is a logical Python package (directory) inside the repository; SPDX Package is the generic packaged-software concept.
Plugins are pluggable runtime extensions; SPDX Extension is the SBOM-side concept for an extension carried on an element.
Hook payloads attach structured runtime observations to elements; SPDX Annotation attaches structured commentary to elements.
Both are the abstract root carrying id, name, summary, description, comment on every concrete subclass.
ModelElement is the architectural-element base used by concrete Mellea specs; closest SPDX analogue is the generic Element root.
Both model a single named field/key entry within a larger structure.
AIPackage carries metric/threshold metadata about an AI model; Mellea TelemetryMetricSpec is the runtime emission analogue.
Backend families denote the model-serving provider; SPDX Agent (Organization/Person/SoftwareAgent) is the closest provenance concept.
Adapters relate to a base model; SPDX Relationship is how such "depends on / variant of" links are expressed.
CLI commands are tool-like operational entry points; SPDX Tool models software tools used during SBOM creation.
